invalid_credentials: Sign-in logs show repeated invalid-password responses for the affected account.
Verify the user's identity and account status; guide them through the approved credential recovery flow. Never request or record the password.
A password change is recorded, but one client continues submitting an old saved credential.
Update the saved credential in the affected client and review stale sessions according to policy.
Other accounts authenticate successfully, while this account receives a credential rejection.
Inspect the affected account's sign-in details and test a fresh sign-in without exposing credentials.
account_locked: Identity logs record an account-lockout event following repeated failed attempts.
Verify identity, identify the source of repeated failures, and unlock only through the approved process.
The account locks again after being unlocked, and failures correlate with one client.
Correlate failed sign-ins by client and source, then update the stale credential at the originating client.
mfa_registration_missing: The sign-in flow requires MFA registration, and the account has no completed authentication method.
Verify identity and eligibility, then guide the user through the approved MFA registration flow.
Authentication details state that a required method is not registered.
Check the authentication-method policy and registration state; do not bypass MFA as a routine workaround.
oauth_consent_missing: The application sign-in trace reports missing consent for a requested permission.
Review the publisher, requested scopes, and business approval; obtain admin consent only through the approved review process.
Requested application scopes are absent from the tenant's granted-consent record.
Compare requested scopes with the approved app registration and route the request to the application owner.
device_noncompliant: Conditional Access evaluation requires a compliant device, and management reports a failed compliance rule.
Inspect the exact failed rule, remediate it, sync the device, and recheck compliance before retrying access.
The sign-in event names device compliance as the block reason, and several device records show the same failed policy.
Confirm policy assignment and the affected device set, remediate the underlying rule, and validate compliance before restoring access.
policy_scope_mismatch: Sign-in records show a Conditional Access policy applied to an unintended group.
Compare include and exclude groups with the approved change, then correct scope through change control.
The affected account is missing from the expected group after a directory change, and policy evaluation confirms the mismatch.
Verify group membership and propagation, review policy impact, and test with a controlled account.
disk_space_exhausted: The endpoint reports less than 1 GB free and application logs show write failures.
Identify approved-to-remove files, clear safe temporary data, and verify free space without deleting user data blindly.
Several managed endpoints report critically low system-drive space, and application logs show write failures on those devices.
Check endpoint telemetry for the common source of disk growth, apply approved cleanup, and verify free space across affected devices.
print_queue_stuck: The print queue contains a job that remains in deleting or spooling state.
Capture printer and job details, clear the stuck job using the approved procedure, and verify a test print.
Several users at the same site have queued jobs that remain stalled while the shared printer is reachable.
Check the shared queue and spooler health, then follow the endpoint support procedure to clear the backlog and verify a test print.
stale_compliance_sync: The management console shows the device last checked in several days ago despite recent user activity.
Verify connectivity and enrollment, trigger a supported management sync, and confirm the updated check-in timestamp.
Many devices in one deployment group have stale compliance timestamps after a management-service disruption.
Check service health and enrollment-agent status, restore sync through the supported process, and verify updated device records.
enrollment_profile_mismatch: The device enrollment record references a profile intended for a different ownership type.
Confirm ownership and platform, then follow the approved re-enrollment path with user-data safeguards.
New devices in the same deployment group are receiving a profile intended for another platform.
Validate group and profile assignment, correct the mapping through change control, and re-enroll only where required.
mailbox_quota_exceeded: Exchange diagnostics show the mailbox at its configured quota and new mail delivery is affected.
Check mailbox usage and retention policy, identify approved cleanup or archive options, and verify mail flow after space is recovered.
Several mailboxes in a defined group have reached their configured quotas and sending is affected.
Review mailbox usage, retention requirements, and capacity policy with the service owner before applying an approved remedy.
outlook_profile_corrupt: Outlook repeatedly fails to load the profile while webmail works for the same account.
Confirm service health and capture diagnostics, then create a test profile following support procedure before replacing the user's profile.
Multiple endpoints show the same Outlook startup failure after a managed client update, while webmail remains available.
Check client deployment and diagnostics, test a clean profile on a controlled device, and preserve local data before rebuilding caches.
site_permission_missing: SharePoint returns access denied for the target library while the site is reachable.
Verify the user's intended role and group membership with the site owner, then grant least-privilege access if approved.
A group of users lost access after a site permission change, while the site itself remains reachable.
Review the approved permission change with the site owner, restore only the intended group access, and verify with a test account.
storage_limit_reached: The site storage report shows the configured limit has been reached and uploads fail.
Review storage usage and retention requirements, remove content only with owner approval, or request capacity through the tenant process.
Storage reports show several sites in one tenant segment have reached their assigned quotas and uploads are failing.
Confirm site-level usage and quota configuration, then follow the approved capacity or cleanup workflow with site owners.
audio_device_unavailable: Teams diagnostics show the selected microphone is disconnected or unavailable to the application.
Check OS device permissions and the selected input/output device, close competing audio applications, and run a test call.
A conference-room Teams setup reports an unavailable shared audio endpoint across multiple scheduled meetings.
Check the room device's connection and OS audio endpoint, then run a controlled test call before the next meeting.
guest_identity_mismatch: The invitation was sent to one email identity, but the guest signed in using a different account.
Confirm the invited address with the resource owner and have the guest switch to the invited identity; re-invite only if approved.
Multiple guests report access failures, and audit records show invitations sent to aliases different from their sign-in identities.
Validate each intended guest identity with the resource owner and correct invitations through the approved guest-access process.
proxy_configuration_invalid: Browser diagnostics show requests routed to an obsolete proxy endpoint.
Compare endpoint proxy settings with the approved configuration, correct the stale value, and test only approved destinations.
Multiple endpoints in the same network segment fail with proxy authentication errors after a configuration change.
Verify proxy address, authentication, and policy assignment with network operations; do not bypass the corporate proxy.
dns_resolution_failure: Name-resolution tests fail for the service hostname while the configured DNS server is unreachable.
Check assigned DNS servers and network/VPN state, then retest resolution after approved remediation.
Several endpoints at different sites return failures for the same service hostname, and DNS telemetry shows a common record problem.
Compare the failing record with authoritative DNS data and escalate stale or missing records to the DNS owner.
suspicious_signin_detected: Identity protection marks one sign-in as high risk and the source location is inconsistent with the user's known activity.
Follow the security incident playbook, preserve sign-in evidence, verify the user through a trusted channel, and escalate for containment.
Risk telemetry identifies anomalous sign-ins across several accounts with a shared indicator.
Review correlated sign-in and audit events, preserve evidence, and escalate promptly under the security playbook; containment requires authorized security approval.
legacy_auth_blocked: Sign-in logs identify a legacy authentication client blocked by tenant policy for one user.
Identify the client and dependent workflow, migrate it to modern authentication, and retain the block unless an approved exception exists.
Multiple sign-in events show a legacy protocol used by a shared business application, and policy blocks those attempts.
Confirm the protocol and application owner, plan migration to modern authentication, and retain the block unless a formal exception is approved.
